# Image prompting fundamentals

**The prompt structure, vocabulary and per-model dialects that turn an idea into the image you meant, on any 2026 model.**

Teaches how to write image prompts that work across 2026 image models — the five-block prompt structure, camera/lens/light/film vocabulary, aspect ratios and resolutions, per-model dialects (Nano Banana narrative prompts, GPT Image 2.5 preserve lists and quoted text, FLUX.2 JSON prompts with HEX colours, Seedream batches, Midjourney V7 parameters), where negative prompts work and where they don't, and the estimate → dry run → capped run loop with @useclaudia/media and the claudia CLI. Use when writing any still-image prompt, choosing an image model, translating a prompt between models, or debugging a prompt that keeps producing the wrong thing.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Create](../README.md) | beginner | 25 min | `@useclaudia/media`, `@useclaudia/cli` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-08 |

## How it works

1. Write the brief in one sentence first
2. Build the prompt from five blocks, in this order
3. Pick the format before the prompt
4. Choose the model for the job
5. Speak each model's dialect
6. Use negatives only where they exist
7. Run the estimate → dry run → capped run loop
8. Iterate one variable at a time
9. Fix the usual failures

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/image-prompting-fundamentals.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/image-prompting-fundamentals.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/image-prompting-fundamentals.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/image-prompting-fundamentals.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill image-prompting-fundamentals`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `image-prompting-fundamentals.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/image-prompting-fundamentals`.
